title: PKB-001 provider-neutral reverse evidence bundle
description: Reverse-experiment evidence binding for one exact repository revision (PKB-BL-009 / PKB-REVERSE-002). Binds the analyzed repository identity and canonical revision to all three required evidence channels (STRUCTURAL, TEST_BEHAVIOR, DELIVERY_HISTORY), each pinned by repository-relative input path, frozen SHA-256 digest, schema version, and provider provenance, plus its parsed observation payload. Observations are mechanical evidence, never Product semantics. Mirrors com.featuredeliveryintelligence.fdi.reverse.evidence.ReverseEvidenceBundle; the Java validator remains the fail-closed authority.

channels.description: Exactly one record per required channel. The Java bundle validator enforces presence, uniqueness, and cross-channel identity agreement fail-closed.

observations.description: Parsed, channel-specific normalized observation payload. Opaque to this contract: STRUCTURAL, TEST_BEHAVIOR, and DELIVERY_HISTORY adapters place their own normalized trees here without changing the bundle shape.
